# Kit Repository Brief

This repository contains workshop takeaways for AGL's GitHub Copilot champions.
It is not meter-platform and contains no running meter or billing service.

Everything under `01-repo-brief` through `06-champion-playbook` is template or
teaching content, not live instructions. Keep `.template.md` and `.template.json`
suffixes until champions copy files into their own repositories.

Write concise, practical Australian English. Keep Copilot facts source-grounded
and sample data synthetic. Use the approved public meter-platform sample URL;
use example.com for other illustrative URLs. Never include internal URLs or secrets.

Use Node.js 22 or newer, `npm ci --ignore-scripts`, then `npm run validate`.
Keep each Markdown file to one H1. Update copying guidance when a template changes.
